# Penguino

> Penguino is a free, private creative toolkit that runs locally in the browser. Files are processed on the user's device and do not require a backend or account.

## Main Pages

- /: Dashboard and directory of available tools.
- /text-graphic: Create branded text graphics using custom fonts, colours, spacing and export sizes.
- /image-resizer: Resize a single PNG, JPEG or WebP image to exact pixel dimensions.
- /file-converter: Convert images between PNG, JPEG and WebP formats.
- /image-optimiser: Compress an image locally with adjustable quality and a before-and-after comparison.
- /background-remover: Remove connected solid or simple image backgrounds and export a transparent PNG.
- /favicon-generator: Generate favicon PNG files, Apple Touch and Android icons, a web manifest and HTML markup.
- /bulk-image-resizer: Resize up to 10 images together and download the results as a ZIP archive.
- /pdf-compressor: Reduce PDF file size locally by rendering and compressing document pages.
- /metadata-remover: Remove EXIF, location and other embedded metadata from images.
- /file-packer: Bundle up to 50 files into a downloadable ZIP archive.
- /colour-palette-extractor: Extract HEX colour palettes from images and download them as CSS.
- /settings: Penguino preferences.
- /about: The story behind Penguino and its creator, Jon Whitby of StudioJWD.
- /terms: Penguino terms and conditions.

## Privacy and Processing

- Image and PDF processing happens in the browser.
- Brand presets and editor preferences are stored in local browser storage.
- No account or server-side file upload is required.

## Ownership

Penguino is built by StudioJWD: https://studiojwd.com/
